title: Deep learning on touchscreen typing screens fine-motor impairment in Parkinson's disease
summary: Deep networks trained in initialization and fine-tuning stages estimated fine-motor impairment from smartphone typing. In a validation dataset of 36,000 typing sessions from 39 subjects (22 PD, 17 healthy) the AUC was 0.89, with 0.90 sensitivity and 0.83 specificity, and estimates correlated with UPDRS Part III items. An AUC of 0.97 was reported for 9 de novo patients versus 17 controls and 0.79 for 253 remote participants with self-reported health status.
